question: Using Section 7B.05 and Figure 7B-2, describe the required sign sequence for entering and leaving a reduced school speed-limit zone.
model_answer: Direct Answer: Entering a reduced school speed limit zone, a driver first encounters a School (S1-1) sign installed in advance of the zone, optionally preceded/accompanied by a Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5 or S4-5a) sign where the speed drop exceeds 10 mph. At the point where the zone begins, a School Speed Limit assembly (SCHOOL plaque + SPEED LIMIT sign + time-period or condition plaque) or a School Speed Limit When Flashing (S5-1) sign must be posted. Leaving the zone, the downstream end must be marked with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign, which may be accompanied by a standard Speed Limit (R2-1) sign showing the downstream limit. Standards (mandatory): - "A School Speed Limit assembly (see Figure 7B-1) or a School Speed Limit When Flashing (S5-1) sign (see Figure 7B-1) shall be used to indicate the speed limit where a reduced school speed limit zone has been established... The School Speed Limit assembly or School Speed Limit When Flashing sign shall be placed at or as near as practicable to the point where the reduced school speed limit zone begins (see Figures 7B-2 and 7B-4)." - "If a reduced school speed limit zone has been established, a School (S1-1) sign shall be installed in advance (see Table 2C-3 for advance placement guidelines) of the first School Speed Limit sign assembly or S5-1 sign that is encountered in each direction as traffic approaches the reduced school speed limit zone (see Figures 7B-2 and 7B-4)." - "Except as provided in Paragraph 4 of this Section, the downstream end of an authorized and posted reduced school speed limit zone shall be identified with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign (see Figures 7B-1, 7B-2, and 7B-4)." - "If used, the Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead sign shall be followed by a School Speed Limit sign or a School Speed Limit assembly." - "If exceeding the speed limit is the only traffic violation that is subject to higher fines, a FINES HIGHER (R2-6P), FINES DOUBLE (R2-6aP), or $XX FINE (R2-6bP) plaque shall be posted with the School Speed Limit (S5-1) sign and shall not be posted beneath the School Zone (S1-1) sign." Guidance (recommended): - "A Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5 or S4-5a) sign (see Figure 7B-1) should be used to inform road users of a reduced speed zone where the speed limit is being reduced by more than 10 mph, or where engineering judgment indicates that advance notice would be appropriate." Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 7B-2 shows the full sequence in each direction of travel: an S1-1 School sign (with optional S4-3P SCHOOL plaque), an S4-5 Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead sign, the School Speed Limit assembly (S4-3P SCHOOL plaque, R2-1 SPEED LIMIT 20, S4-1P time plaque) at the zone entrance, and an S5-3 END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (or S5-2 END SCHOOL ZONE) sign with an optional R2-1 SPEED LIMIT 45 at the exit. [Image 2] Figure 7B-1 depicts the component signs, including the School Speed Limit assembly options (S4-3P, R2-1, S4-1P, S4-2P, S4-4P, S4-6P), the S5-1 When Flashing sign, the S4-5/S4-5a advance signs, and the S5-2/S5-3 end-of-zone signs. [Image 3] Page 1019 contains the Section 7B.05 Standard text requiring the assembly at the zone start, the advance S1-1 sign, and the S5-3 sign at the downstream end. [Image 4] Page 1024 shows Section 7B.06 provisions relating higher-fines plaques and end-of-zone signing. [Image 5] Page 1016 shows the same Figure 7B-2 layout with the sequence of signs on both approaches to the school. [Image 6] Page 1020 shows Figure 7B-4, a parallel example where the School Speed Limit assembly includes a fines plaque and the zone ends with S5-3 or S5-2 plus an optional R2-1. Citations: - Section 7B.05 Standard §1 (p.978) - Section 7B.05 Standard §2 (p.978) - Section 7B.05 Standard §3 (p.978) - Section 7B.05 Standard §14 (p.980) - Section 7B.05 Guidance §13 (p.980) - Section 7B.06 Standard §3 (p.980) - Figure 7B-2 (p.975) - Figure 7B-1 (p.973) - Page 1019 - Page 1024 - Page 1016 - Page 1020
gold_answer: Approaching traffic first encounters an advance School (S1-1) sign, then the School Speed Limit assembly or S5-1 at the beginning of the reduced zone. The downstream end is normally marked by S5-3 END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT; S5-2 END SCHOOL ZONE may be used when both zones end together, with a downstream R2-1 optionally mounted.
